            function parseArray(tokens, i) {
              const out = [];
              i++; // skip '['

                if (tokens[i] === '[') {

                  out.push(child); // Fixed: out.push(...child) was causing flattening

                } else if (tokens[i] !== ',') {

            <code_snippet>
function parseArray(tokens, i) {
  const out = [];
  i++; // skip '['
  while (tokens[i] !== ']') {
    if (tokens[i] === '[') {
      const [child, j] = parseArray(tokens, i);
      out.push(child); // Fixed
      i = j;
    } else if (tokens[i] !== ',') {
      out.push(parseValue(tokens[i]));
      i++;
    } else {
      i++;
    }
  }
  return [out, i + 1];
}
